headline: On October 31, 2011: Global population hits 7 billion
instagramCaption:
The world welcomed its 7 billionth human. \\[It took 300,000 years to reach 1 billion and only 218 more years to hit 8 billion. The United Nations recognized this day as the Day of Seven Billion, marking a significant milestone in global demographics. This event highlights the rapid growth of the world's population. Why does it still matter today? It underscores the challenges and opportunities in managing resources for a growing planet. \\What do you think is the biggest challenge with a growing population? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
